title: Store: failing tests for unresolved #6053 review threads
body:
## Changelog Entry

None. This PR only adds tests (label `no-changelog`).

## Description

This PR adds failing tests for the two review threads on #6053 that are still unresolved. It doesn't fix either issue. The branch is based on `feat-new-store`, so this PR should target that branch.

## Specific Changes

- **`FrozenNodeSet.ts:17`: a string and a node reference with the same ID are treated as the same value** (`FrozenNodeSet.test.ts`)
   - `getEqualityKey()` maps both `'_:b'` and `{ '@id': '_:b' }` to `'_:b'`. `union()` and `symmetricDifference()` keep whichever comes first and drop the other.
   - The tests cover both insertion orders.

   ```ts
   new FrozenNodeSet(['_:a']).union(new Set(['_:b', { '@id': '_:b' }]));
   // Expected: [{ '@id': '_:a' }, '_:b', { '@id': '_:b' }]
   // Actual:   [{ '@id': '_:a' }, '_:b']
   ```

- **`VersionedStorage.ts:491`: an overlay iterator loses its place after `commit()`** (`VersionedStorage.test.ts`)
   - After a commit, the iterator skips as many entries as it has already returned, counted from the start of the committed map. Deleting a key it has already passed shifts that count, so it skips too far.
   - Each case is checked against a literal expected list and against a native `Map` doing the same steps:

   | Overlay `[a, b, c]`: read `a`, then… | Expected rest | Actual |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | `delete('a')`, `commit()` | `b, c` | `c` |
   | `delete('a')`, `set('a', 100)`, `commit()` | `b, c, a` | incorrect |

- [x] I have added tests and executed them locally
- [ ] ~I have added `.changelog/<PR#>-<slug>.md`~
- [ ] ~I have updated documentation~
